results.title: Korea Navy Tests AI-Based Unmanned Mine Warfare System
results.description: The Republic of Korea Navy and Hanwha Systems conducted an AI-based unmanned mine warfare combat experiment at Busan Naval Base, testing minesweepers, USVs and AUVs in a simulated port blockade scenario.

results.title: Private equity-backed SG Fleet lobs $770m offer for FleetPartners
results.description: Pacific Equity Partners plans to strengthen its grip on Australia’s vehicle leasing sector with a proposal to merge two of its biggest players.
